questions.question: Which of the following describes the molecular composition of carbon dioxide?
options: One carbon atom and one oxygen atom
One carbon atom and two oxygen atoms
Two carbon atoms and one oxygen atom
Two carbon atoms and two oxygen atoms

questions.question: Approximately what percentage of the Earth's atmosphere is made up of carbon dioxide?
Which of the following gases is classified as a greenhouse gas?
options: Nitrogen
Oxygen
Argon
Carbon dioxide

questions.question: What is the primary consequence of having too many greenhouse gases in the atmosphere?
options: A decrease in average global temperature
An increase in average global temperature, known as global warming
An increase in the concentration of nitrogen gas
A rapid cooling of the Earth's oceans

questions.question: Why does coal burn?
options: It is a sedimentary rock made mostly of carbon, with some impurities
It is a metamorphic rock containing high levels of pure oxygen
It is formed from liquid hydrocarbons trapped in volcanic rocks
It is an igneous rock made of hardened lava

questions.question: From what material did coal originally form over millions of years?
options: Prehistoric animal bones buried in deserts
Deep sediments of organic matter made of prehistoric plants
Volcanic ash mixed with minerals
Dead marine plankton buried under deep oceans

questions.question: What organic material originally formed oil and gas millions of years ago?
options: Dead plankton mixed in with sediments
Prehistoric woody forest trees
Volcanic gases trapped in rock layers
Dinosaur bones buried in sand dunes

questions.question: How does sedimentary rock form from sediments?
options: By being melted in volcanic magma and cooling slowly
By being exposed to extreme heat inside the Earth without pressure
When sediment is buried and compressed, and salts from fluids cement the grains together
When water evaporates completely from a saltwater lake, leaving crystals

questions.question: In which type of rock are fossils exclusively found?
options: Igneous rock
Metamorphic rock
Sedimentary rock
Volcanic rock

questions.question: What chemical process occurs when bones are fossilized in sedimentary rock?
options: The bones are melted by extreme heat and recrystallize
The bones are slowly dissolved by water and replaced by minerals in the water
The bones turn directly into carbon dioxide gas
The bones are preserved intact without any change to their original elements

questions.question: What are the two most abundant gases in Earth's atmosphere?
options: 78% Nitrogen and 21% Oxygen
78% Oxygen and 21% Nitrogen
50% Carbon dioxide and 50% Oxygen
99% Carbon dioxide and 1% Oxygen

questions.question: What is the standard chemical test for identifying carbon dioxide gas?
options: It relights a glowing splint
It produces a squeaky pop when exposed to a lit splint
It turns damp blue litmus paper red
It forms a white precipitate that turns limewater milky

questions.question: What is the term for the process that removes material from where bedrock has been broken down or weathered?
options: Weathering
Deposition
Erosion
Compaction

questions.question: How does the process of combustion affect the Earth's atmosphere?
options: It decreases the amount of nitrogen
It increases the amount of carbon dioxide
It decreases the amount of carbon dioxide
It has no effect on atmospheric gases

questions.question: Which of these biological processes directly reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere?
options: Respiration by animals
Decomposition of dead plants
Photosynthesis by plants and phytoplankton
Combustion of fossil fuels

questions.question: Besides being absorbed by plants, what is another major way carbon dioxide is naturally removed from the atmosphere?
options: It can dissolve in the oceans
It escapes directly into outer space
It reacts with nitrogen to form ammonia
It is frozen into dry ice at the equator
